QuestInfo.name: The Culprit in the Cave
QuestInfo.0: Did she find out who stole the #t4032464#? Ask #b#p1052103##k in #b#m103000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052103# says that the culprit is at their hideout, a cave in #b#m101030500# in #m101000000##k. She wants you to go inside, catch the thief, and restore #m103000000#'s honor. Hurry to #m101000000#.
QuestInfo.2: The cave was empty. You only saw a strange puppet... Is that the culprit?

0.0: I just know it... The thief is in the cave! Thieves, hideouts... things are getting exciting!\r\nAhem. According to the document, they saw the culprit going to #b #b#m101030500# in #m101000000##k. There must be a hideout there somewhere.
0.1: A puppet stole the herbs? Ha. That makes no sense! I suppose that's not important.
0.2: The culprit's hideout is somewhere in #b#m101030500##k in the #m101000000# of North Forest! #bI'll send you there right away#k, so don't let that fiend escape the justice of #m103000000#! Boy, I've always wanted to say that.

no.0: What? You've accused the people of #m103000000# and now you refuse to help? Where is your heart, huh?

1.0: ...\r\n#b#L0#(An ugly wooden puppet that's broken and worn out lies on the floor. There is nothing else here. Could the culprit have gone somewhere?)#l\n#k
1.1: ...\r\n#b#L0#(Anyway, this is the ugliest puppet ever. Who could have brought this ugly thing here?)#l\n#k
1.2: (Flinch)\r\n#b#L0#(Hm? The puppet flinched. Was that your imagination? Go over and give it a nudge.)#l\n#k
1.3: Yikes! Don't touch me!\r\n#b#L0#(The puppet talks!)#l\n#k
1.4: Intruder! How dare you enter my master's cave and try to steal me! I will not forgive you for this! But don't hit me. I can't fight. I'm not a battle puppet.

npc.0: Haven't you caught the culprit yet? I'm telling you, the culprit's hideout is in #b#m101030500##k in the #m101000000# of North Forest!
